data.title: Fix perf ACK framing and reject unreachable validation decoys
data.description: Consumes frozen perf ACKs as exact ack LF NUL frames, preserves the existing ack-LF ledger, emits perf_disable in canonical order, and hardens overlay validation against comment-only, nested dead-code, and unreachable straight-line decoys. Rust comments and literals are blanked for the appropriate scans; required code is depth/order checked; constant conditionals and transfer tokens are rejected except the exact disable availability let-else. All hostile static cases, runner suites, cargo/fmt checks, and real perf/strace rehearsals pass.
